summary: The document represents a web user control for managing COVID-19 immunization status within a health enrollment application. It provides functionality for editing, saving, and managing COVID-19 related data for student records.
purpose: To facilitate the management and update of COVID-19 immunization status for students through a web-based interface.

fields.name: TermID
fields.description: Identifier for the term of study.

fields.name: Covid19StatusCode
fields.description: Status code related to COVID-19 immunization.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Interacts with the web control to manage student immunization records.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Facilitates data binding, updates, and redirects based on user actions.

workflows.name: Editing COVID-19 Immunizations
steps: User accesses the edit page for managing COVID-19 immunizations.
User selects a student record to edit.
User updates COVID-19 status code and administration dates.
User saves changes, which triggers the update function.
System validates changes and provides warnings if necessary.
User confirms update and redirects to applicable page based on selection.

business_rules: Only users with appropriate session rights can proceed with editing.
validations: Ensure that the user session is active before performing operations.
Check if COVID-19 status codes are properly loaded and bound to the dropdown.
calculations: Determine sort direction and expression based on user settings.
conditions: Redirect occurs only if there are no warnings.
system_behavior: Page binds data and controls visibility of buttons based on data row type.
Grid control updates are conditional based on user edits and status codes.
JavaScript is registered for client-side handling of dropdown changes.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnet session for user identification and filter parameters.
exceptions: Cancel operation triggered upon session failure or specific user actions.
